test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All vases are portraits.

Some portraits are flowers.

Conclusions:

(i) All flowers are vases.

(ii) Some flowers may be portraits.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fce2d49fca197ef36d888a04d2c6aa878b2b6030550205d9ee8246ce4bee05c2.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(i) All flowers are vases → False (As there is no direct relation between flowers and vases. so, All flowers are vases can be a possibility but definite)

(ii) Some flowers may be portraits → **True **(As, Some portraits are flowers.so, Some flowers may be portraits is always true).

Thus, 
;Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
